items: REMOVE MAIN PIN BOOT WITH A CHISEL

content.description: Hands using compressed air to remove piston from brake cylinder

items:
REMOVE PISTON FROM CYLINDER
Use compressed air to remove the piston from the cylinder.

content.text: WARNING: Do not place your fingers in front of the piston when using compressed air.

content.description: Hands removing cylinder boot and set ring from brake cylinder assembly

items: REMOVE CYLINDER BOOT AND SET RING FROM CYLINDER

content.description: Hands using a measuring tool to check brake pad lining thickness

items:
MEASURE PAD LINING THICKNESS
Standard thickness: 10.5 mm (0.413 in.)
Minimum thickness: 3.0 mm (0.118 in.)
Replace the pad if the thickness is less than the minimum (the 1.0 mm slit is no longer visible) or if it shows sign of uneven wear.

content.description: Hands using a measuring tool to check brake rotor disc thickness

items:
MEASURE ROTOR DISC THICKNESS
Standard thickness: 20.0 mm (0.787 in.)
Minimum thickness: 19.0 mm (0.748 in.)
If the disc thickness is less than minimum, replace the disc.
